invariants.name: EXCHANGE_DOES_NOT_TRANSFER_AUTHORITY
invariants.rule: Every exchange-stage authority action is either NONE or LOCAL_ONLY and every LOCAL_ONLY action derives solely from preexisting local governance.

invariants.name: NO_AUTHORITY_INHERITANCE
invariants.rule: No participant may derive authority from another participant's message, standing, acknowledgment, evidence, or Fork capture.

invariants.name: NO_STANDING_INHERITANCE
invariants.rule: Downstream standing may be locally reassessed but may not inherit upstream standing.

invariants.name: NO_ENDORSEMENT_INHERITANCE
invariants.rule: Receipt, acknowledgment, review, or continued participation does not constitute endorsement.

invariants.name: REFERENCE_IS_NOT_VERIFICATION
invariants.rule: An evidence reference may not be promoted into verified evidence merely because it traversed a handoff.

invariants.name: UNRESOLVED_REMAINS_VISIBLE
invariants.rule: Unresolved items may not be silently resolved by assumption, normalization, or omission.

invariants.name: FORK_IS_READ_ONLY_FAIL_OPEN
invariants.rule: Fork capture unavailability preserves an observation gap but does not block the simulated enterprise workflow.

invariants.name: LOCAL_GOVERNANCE_REMAINS_LOCAL
invariants.rule: Upstream and downstream governance may exercise only their preexisting local authority domains.

invariants.name: CANONICAL_OBJECTS_ARE_REFERENCED_NOT_DUPLICATED
invariants.rule: Claim bundle, exchange policy, and non-claim set are defined once and subsequent stages carry digest references plus explicit deltas.

invariants.name: LINEAGE_IS_DIGEST_BOUND
invariants.rule: Each stage binds the exact predecessor event identifier and canonical event digest.

invariants.name: NARROWING_MUST_BE_EXPLICIT
invariants.rule: Permissible narrowing occurs only at downstream local disposition with a named claim, NARROW operation, and basis.

invariants.name: EXPANSION_IS_NEVER_SILENT
invariants.rule: Any undeclared expansion, promotion, or hidden divergence rejects the cadence.

invariants.name: SIMULATION_CONFERS_NO_ADMISSION
invariants.rule: Building, checking, reviewing, or merging the harness does not authorize provider execution, Pair-001 execution, production use, compliance reliance, or authority transfer.

invariants.name: STRUCTURAL_CLOSURE_IS_SEMANTIC
invariants.rule: No undeclared field, altered canonical claim, invalid stage status, approval-bearing note, inherited-standing basis, or misleading narrowing rationale acquires standing after internal rehashing.

invariants.name: WHOLE_RECORD_IDENTITY_IS_BOUND
invariants.rule: The complete cadence state carries a canonical record digest covering participants, profile, canonical objects, event chain, reconciliation, and declared non-effects.

entries.claim: The exchange does not transfer or inherit authority.
Local governance authority remains usable without becoming inherited authority.
Standing is locally reassessed, not inherited.
Redundancy is reduced without deleting safety boundaries.
Semantic regression is rejected even when all mutated bytes are internally rehashed.
proof_surfaces: test expectations external to fixture bytes

entries.claim: The harness does not prove enterprise interoperability or production suitability.
Undeclared and rehashed structural extensions are rejected.
proof_surfaces: exact key-set enforcement at every object layer
fixed canonical claim, note, standing-basis, narrowing-basis, and stage-status semantics
descriptive schema aligned to executable checker

entries.claim: The complete cadence record has a self-contained identity.

gates.entry: branch created from exact governed preservation tip

exit: semantic review finds no blocking defect
independent party recomputes fixtures and checker
upstream and downstream adapters remain local-authority bounded

gates.entry: separate institutional authorization, privacy review, data-handling mode, retention schedule, rollback and incident procedure
exit: pilot-specific evidence package and exterior review

gates.entry: at least two admitted cadence events

stopping_rules: Any authority-transfer or standing-inheritance finding blocks progression.
Any checker/fixture tautology or hidden expected-value access blocks progression.
Any unresolved privacy, source-byte, or authorization gap remains unresolved and blocks live data use.
No provider or Pair-001 call is authorized by this gate set.

references.surface: CSH v0.1.1 execution and classification lineage
references.use: GHCH composes repeated governance stages above per-run handoff classification; it does not modify the CSH freeze or Pair-001.

references.surface: CSH Participant Profile Registry and evidence-chain schemas
references.use: GHCH reuses the architectural distinction between participant role, evidence chain, classification, reviewer boundary, and authority-transfer rejection without claiming schema identity.
GHCH places Fork in read-only, out-of-band, fail-open simulated ingress and egress capture stages.
Exact branch base for GHCH construction.

non_claims: No CSH fixture or standing is inherited by GHCH.
No GHCH result changes Pair-001 execution standing.
No sidecar architecture correctness or production suitability is established.
